# Alpha — `magus-alpha`

Experimental. Interfaces change without notice, and a plugin may be withdrawn.

[magus](../../guides/install.md) lists this marketplace before you add it — select it,
confirm, and it is registered:

```bash
magus
```

For a team, pin the plugins in `.claude/profiles.json` and everyone runs
`magus install` — see [Teams and profiles](../../guides/teams.md).

Plugin IDs carry the marketplace, so these are `name@magus-alpha`.

| Plugin | Version | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`claudoom`](./claudoom.md) | 0.1.0 | Plays Doom-engine WADs in a Claude Code pane: runs doom-cli (GPLv2, built from upstream) in a private tmux server and repaints its frames into a Raster. Fetches Freedoom (BSD) on demand. DOOM is a ZeniMax trademark; not affiliated with id Software, ZeniMax or Anthropic. |

Turn any of them on from the Plugins tab. To give a team the same set, press `s` to save
your selection as a profile and commit it — see [Teams and profiles](../../guides/teams.md).

[Advanced Usage](../../guides/advanced-usage.md) covers global installs, version pinning and
updates.
